author: Bellular News
description:
PlayStation has dropped Kojima's next espionage game, and Xbox is picking it up. Sony's willingness to back ambitious games helped make PlayStation what it is. What happens when it's too scared to keep doing that?

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
